## What this region is

The approval seam on every session (gates that allow, deny or rewrite each tool call) and the secret scratch pad that lets an agent use a secret by reference without reading its value, enforced by a private-path gate.

## What it exists for

- Decide whether an agent's tool call may run
- Stop the agent reading secret files
- Let the agent use a secret without seeing it
- Read and write scratch references

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- map our plan mode to a Codex sandbox and approval policy → transports
- give Muse an explicit permission profile so its reviewer stops approving → transports
- the tool_use events are missing from the turn result → session-contract
- stop the turn and wait until the runtime confirms it stopped → session-contract
